Hair fit matrix

Generated by scripts/fit_hair.py: every hairstyle in assets/hair_raw/, warped from the base head (dimple_oval) onto each head. Drawn as the game draws it: hair_back behind the head, then hair_base, hair_bangs and hair_lines in front. Check for scalp showing between hair and head, and for hair cutting into the face or ears.
